items.title: Record rollout findings and publish Lattice install guidance
items.context: Capture M1 real-project rollout findings and update README/docs so the primary command is lattice, koala is legacy alias, and local global refresh steps are explicit.
items.userSees: 用户在 README/guide 中看到 `lattice check`、`lattice doctor`、`lattice session_brief`、`lattice rollout_check`，并看到 `koala` 标注为 legacy alias。

happy.desc: README/docs guide publish local/global refresh steps and primary examples with lattice check, lattice doctor, lattice session_brief, and lattice rollout_check.

edge.desc: Docs preserve necessary koala references only for legacy alias, .koala state, koala-codex adapter, package identity, or historical reviewer lane context.

adversarial.desc: General install and rollout guidance must not tell users to prefer koala check/doctor/session_brief over lattice equivalents.

verificationEvidence.note: README, docs/guide, and project vision publish lattice as the primary entrypoint, include local/global refresh commands, and document rollout_check.
Docs preserve koala references only for legacy alias, package/path, adapter, and historical state semantics.
No general docs guidance tells users to prefer koala for check/doctor/session_brief/rollout workflows; lattice is primary.

items.title: Make user-facing CLI help and hints prefer lattice
items.context: Update help banners, next-step hints, doctor/check/session output, and command examples so invoked or recommended commands say lattice by default while keeping koala compatibility.
items.userSees: 用户执行 `lattice story_create --help` 时看到 `lattice story_create` 示例和 `lattice session_brief` 下一步；执行 `koala --version` 仍看到 legacy alias 说明。

happy.desc: lattice story_create --help and session/next-step guidance prefer lattice command examples for user actions.

edge.desc: koala remains a working legacy alias and version/help output explicitly frames it as legacy compatibility.

adversarial.desc: Command-language migration does not rename .koala paths, koala-review-* lanes, KOALA_* env vars, bin/koala-codex.js, or @koala-agent/core package identity.

items.title: Add read-only lattice rollout_check command
items.context: Implement a cross-project rollout checker that scans selected roots or project lists for global CLI version, lattice/koala realpath, config doctor status, session/doctor/check status, managed asset drift, and transcript lifecycle readiness without modifying projects.
items.userSees: 用户执行 `lattice rollout_check --projects /path/a,/path/b --json` 时看到 `summary.total`、`summary.pass/warn/fail` 和每个项目的 `status`、`nextAction`。

happy.desc: lattice rollout_check --projects <paths> --json returns stable summary counts and per-project status/nextAction records.

edge.desc: External or non-Lattice projects are normalized into WARN/SKIP-style project results with evidence snippets instead of opaque command failures.

adversarial.desc: rollout_check never invokes apply/repair commands and does not change scanned project git status.

items.title: Verify rollout_check and lattice command semantics across real projects
items.context: Add focused smoke tests plus a real-project transcript covering Orchestrate, Koala/Koala, plasmid, minicell, OpenCli, and avalon behavior from M1.
items.userSees: 用户在 TEST transcript 中看到 `Orchestrate: pass`, `plasmid: warn`, `minicell: warn`, `OpenCli: warn`, `avalon: warn`，以及 `transcript lifecycle readiness: pass`。

happy.desc: rollout-check smoke test passes and real-project TEST transcript records Orchestrate plus external project statuses with actionable next actions.

edge.desc: rollout_check explains managed asset drift warnings from external projects without treating every nonzero check exit as a framework failure.

adversarial.desc: global transcript lifecycle readiness remains pass, proving B-f3db behavior survives the lattice command migration and rollout checker.
